column1: JV3 COMPUTE COOPERATIVE - PARTNER SUMMARY (v3.2 - TRAINING-HEAVY WORKING CASE)

Three AI labs jointly build 140MW of NVIDIA compute in France. Each member owns an equal ~1/3 sleeve of every tranche and guarantees its own demand. GB300 starts in rented colo space within 6 months; a dedicated campus is built for the Vera Rubin generations. Working case assumes TRAINING-HEAVY workloads (full fat-tree fabric + rich storage = 20% uplift on rack systems); the leaner 15% rail-optimized case is shown side-by-side at the bottom. Full detail: jv_economics_v3.csv.

The uplift covers the rack-to-rack fabric + storage + spares. Training-heavy = full fat-tree at high bisection + rich storage tier (~$11k/GPU); rail-optimized (~$8k/GPU) fits inference/mixed workloads.

GB300 rack price $4.0M - verified Jul 2026: top of the corroborated $3.7-4.0M street band (Loop Capital: Apple ~$1B / ~250 racks), set high as a memory-inflation buffer. Stress case $4.5M; a weakly-sourced $6M+ 'inference-optimized' config tail exists. NVIDIA publishes no list price.

What's included where - NETWORKING: in-rack NVLink + NICs are inside the rack price; the rack-to-rack fabric + storage + spares are the 20% uplift. COOLING: cold plates/manifolds are in the rack price; facility cooling (CDUs, chilled water, heat rejection) is in the colo fee for GB300 and in the $8.5/W campus cost for Rubin blocks; cooling energy is in the power bill via PUE 1.20. Pin in the colo LOI whether sidecar CDUs are landlord- or tenant-furnished (~$2-5M/sleeve if tenant).

Scope note: earlier drafts quoted ~$270M per GB300 sleeve INCLUDING a $61M owned-building share. GB300 now rents colo, so the sleeve is chips-only ($230M at the training uplift) and the building cost appears instead as ~$50M of colo fees over 5 years. Like-for-like owned at the verified $4.0M price would be ~$291M.

Compute equivalence anchored in FP8 training flops (dense) - deliberately NOT the FP4 marketing metric. GB300 4.5 PF / Rubin 17.5 PF / Ultra 34.7 PF per GPU package; per-watt multipliers ~2.4x (Rubin) and ~3.5x (Ultra) vs GB300.
T6-T7 (Rubin Ultra) are OPTIONS exercised only at NVIDIA spec freeze - not fixed commitments. Rubin/Ultra pricing preliminary; GB300 firm.

Loans amortize monthly over 5 years; rates step down as the JV builds credit history (9.5% first close to 8.0%). Not netted: ~$0.27B per member of chip residual value (10%) and the campus building's residual life (15+yr asset charged over 5).
Interest starts at GPU purchase - each GB300 sleeve pays ~$6.7M of interest during the 6-month rack-up before compute goes live.
Members pay via take-or-pay contracts (reserved-capacity fee payable irrespective of usage) - this is what the loans are underwritten on.
